scaling: StandardScaler on all numeric/encoded columns (fit on the full 431-row cohort for this final refit; fold-safe / training-fold-only for Part A's CV)
bmi_before_note: BMI_before is fold-safe-recomputed from height and weight_before_pregnancy (FoldSafeRecomputedBMITransformer) -- here fit on the full cohort, not a fold.
categorical_encoding: OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown='ignore') for derived_hypertension_pih_pet_spectrum (full-dummy, penalized model -- not reference/drop-first coding)
missingness: median impute (numeric) / most-frequent impute (categorical) fit on the full cohort
